ANITRAIN · QUESTIONS

Anime energy. Real daily fitness.

AniTrain is built for anime fans and for anyone who simply wants a more motivating way to train at home, improve strength, add cardio, work on mobility and stay consistent.

Is AniTrain an anime workout app?

Yes. AniTrain uses anime-inspired motivation and story elements around practical workouts, while keeping the training useful for everyday fitness.

Do I need to be an anime fan?

No. You can use AniTrain for daily movement, bodyweight strength, cardio, mobility and recovery even if anime is not your main reason for training.

Can I use AniTrain for home workouts?

Yes. The site and journal include home-friendly bodyweight ideas alongside cardio, mobility and routine-building guidance.

Where can I download AniTrain?

AniTrain is currently available on Android through Google Play. Use the Download button at the top of the page.
